pages.title: Contact us
pages.html:
Questions about a guide, an order or a download? Email support@pdfblueprints.store.

For order support, include your order reference, the email used at checkout and the name of the guide. Please do not send card details or passwords.

We aim to respond within two business days.

Write to us ↗

pages.title: Your privacy choices
pages.html:
The replacement storefront does not include advertising pixels or an advertising-cookie system. Checkout is provided separately by Payhip.

To request access, correction or deletion of your personal information, or to raise a privacy concern, contact support@pdfblueprints.store. Include enough information for us to identify your request.

See our privacy policy for information about store, checkout and support providers.
